humanSummary: This repo has no test command configured, so LCARS cannot prove a ticket's work — and did not hire anyone to attempt it. Establish a test runner, or point LCARS at one with `lcars update --test-command`.
technicalDetail:
This mission cannot start: no test command is configured for this repo, so LCARS has no way to prove any work — every ticket is proven by RUNNING its tests (red on the parent commit, green on the tip).
LCARS's test-readiness verdict for this repo: ◇ NO TEST SYSTEMS FOUND — a greenfield repo; the first mission's engineering crew will establish them.
No worker was hired: LCARS stopped before spending anything, because a paid session here could not have been proven either way.
What to do next — whichever fits this repo: establish a test runner here, or point LCARS at a runner this repo already has (that verdict is read at the REPO ROOT, so a monorepo whose packages test fine can still land on it). Either way, set the command with `lcars update --test-command '<command>'` (or `lcars update --fix-tests`, which walks you through it).
